about:
# MacTotem

WoW Forever addon for shamans that keeps one macro casting the totems of the active totem
bar page in sequence.

## Features

- **Totem macro** - the general (account) macro `MacTotem` holds a `/castsequence` of
  the totems set on the active page of the Blizzard totem bar (Call of the Elements,
  Ancestors, or Spirits).
- **Cast order per set** - for each totem set (Call of the Elements, Ancestors, Spirits)
  choose which element (Earth, Fire, Water, Air) is cast first, second, third, and
  fourth, or None to skip a totem (None always moves to the end); default is Earth, Fire,
  Water, Air.
- **Never deleted** - MacTotem only creates and rewrites the macro, never deletes it;
  each shaman with MacTotem rewrites it for their own totem bar on login.
- **Always in sync** - the macro updates when you assign or remove a totem or switch the
  page; changes made in combat apply right after combat.
- **Reset timer** - the sequence restarts after combat and, optionally, after 1-60
  seconds without a cast.
- **Shamans only** - other classes get no macro.
- **Remembered** - settings are saved per account, or per character with one checkbox;
  default is off.
- **Settings page** - all options in the game menu under Options > AddOns, also opened
  from the addon compartment menu.
- **Chat commands** - every option can also be changed by slash command.

## Screenshots

![The MacTotem macro with the totems of the active page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/MacTotem/main/docs/macro.png)

![Settings page with the cast order per totem set](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tf4482/MacTotem/main/docs/settings.png)

## Install

1. Download `MacTotem-vX.Y.Z.zip` from the
   [releases](https://github.com/tf4482/MacTotem/releases) (or CurseForge).
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.
4. Type `/mt on`, then drag `MacTotem` from the macro window (`/macro`, general tab)
   onto an action bar.

## Usage

```text
/mt                              show the state and the totems of the active page
/mt on                           manage the macro
/mt off                          stop managing the macro (the macro stays as it is)
/mt restart <s>                  restart the sequence after s seconds, 0 = only after combat
/mt order <set> <a> [b] [c] [d]  cast order of set 1-3: earth, fire, water, air; left out = none
/mt character on                 use settings for this character only
/mt character off                use the account settings again
/mt test                         write the macro once now and show its text
/mt reset                        reset the settings to defaults
/mt debug on                     show what the addon does, until /reload
/mt config                       open the settings page
/mt help                         list all commands
```

`/mactotem` works as well (in case another addon already uses `/mt`).

## Examples

- Totem bar page 1 holds Strength of Earth, Searing, Healing Stream, and Windfury: the
  macro becomes `/castsequence reset=combat Strength of Earth Totem, Searing Totem, ...`;
  press it four times to drop all four.
- `/mt order 2 fire earth air water`: with Call of the Ancestors active, the macro drops
  the fire totem first and the water totem last; the settings page shows the same order
  under the Call of the Ancestors header.
- `/mt order 1 earth air`: Call of the Elements drops only the earth and air totems; fire
  and water show None at positions 3 and 4.
- `/mt restart 8` gives `reset=combat/8`: pausing 8 seconds starts again at the first
  totem.
- `/mt character on` on an alt, then `/mt order 1 fire earth`: only this shaman uses
  that order; the other characters keep the account order.
- Switch the totem bar to Call of the Spirits: the macro follows that page at once, or
  right after combat.

## Develop

Check the code with [Luacheck](https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck) before each commit
(CI runs it on every push):

```text
luacheck .
```

Deploy locally: run `deploy.bat`; it builds `release/MacTotem-vX.Y.Z.zip` from `VERSION`.

Release: set `VERSION` to `X.Y.Z`, then push an annotated tag `vX.Y.Z`; GitHub Actions
packages the addon with the BigWigs packager and publishes it.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.2.0] - 2026-11-24

### Added

- "Per character" checkbox on the settings page and `/mt character on|off`: settings for
  this character only, or the account's.
- `/mt test` writes the macro once now and shows its text.
- `/mt reset` restores the default settings; `/mt debug on|off` shows what the addon does.

### Changed

- The reset timer command is now `/mt restart <s>`; enabled users see one chat line about
  it once. Saved settings stay as they are.
- Release zips no longer contain the icon image.

### Fixed

- Loading no longer fails when the saved cast order needs tidying before the settings
  page is built.
- Logging in or entering the world no longer creates a second `MacTotem` macro before
  the macro list is loaded.

## [0.1.2] - 2026-11-19

### Fixed

- Opening the key bindings in the options no longer reports that MacTotem was blocked
  from an action only available to the Blizzard UI.

## [0.1.1] - 2026-11-18

### Changed

- Release zips no longer contain the `VERSION` file.
- README shows screenshots of the macro and the settings page.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-18

### Added

- General (account) macro `MacTotem` with a `/castsequence` of the totems on the active
  totem bar page, updated when totems or the page change.
- Cast order of the elements per totem set, chosen on the settings page or with
  `/mt order`.
- None in the cast order skips a totem; it always moves to the end.
- Settings page, compartment entry, and `/mt` chat commands.
- Release zips named `MacTotem-vX.Y.Z.zip` on GitHub and CurseForge.
